filmBrief: Same traditional lyrics and 15 individually cued scenes as the detailed Skin and Bones. Simple scissor-cut felt shapes based on the approved preview. Separate native feet, arms, lantern, door, bones and cutout OOH letters. Fixed flat-board camera; distinct fireside, cottage, graveyard and closet sets. Every lyric and each of six oohs waits indefinitely for a student press. The ghost appears only on the final BOO cue. All artwork is editable and portable in the story and standalone classroom export.
